paragraphs: Yosef ben Peksas developed a growth in his leg. He told the physician, when cutting, to leave a hair’s breadth. He told his son Nechunyah: ‘Go out, for one does not become impure for a limb from his living father.’ The verse was applied to him ‘A righteous man perishes in his righteousness’; his righteousness stayed with him. Sifra, Emor, and Semachot 4:28: Yosef Paskas. Jerusalem Talmud, Nazir, Kohen Gadol: Yose.
